First you get some tests and questions regarding your lifrstyle, what to improve, etc, it's all very promising and trying to sell the app as a guideline, or helpful improvement tool, but after subscription, you're left alone with a blank canvas to fill, no guidelines whatsoever. All in all, this is only a calendar with some fancy graphics, no really useful or deeply editable routines, you can't even add individual names to them, only choose from a list.
